description: maps.helcom.fi: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in HELCOM Metadata catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.helcom.fi. Coverage: maps.helcom.fi. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: HELCOM 1x1km Baltic Sea grid; HELCOM 20x20km Baltic Sea grid; Discharge of warm water from nuclear power plants (HOLAS 2); HELCOM 10x10km Baltic Sea grid. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-helcom-fi.
